app.name: Reclaim
_: Reclaim's voice, keyed screen.element, bundled with the app. Every line here was written against the rules in CLAUDE.md: zero setup, the Caregiver voice, and the knowledge test (what does the app actually know, and when did it learn it). Never show what was missed. Never compare people. Never name someone who hasn't acted.
home.headline: Ready when you are.
home.body: Put your phone in the box. That's all there is to it.
home.week.label: This week
pair.headline: Meet your box.
pair.body: Scan the card that came with it, with your phone beside the box. That's the only setup there is.
scan.prompt: The card that came with your box.
scan.found.headline: Listening for your box.
scan.paired.headline: There it is.
scan.paired.body: Put your phone in any slot. That's all there is to it.
scan.notheard.headline: Not hearing it yet.
scan.notheard.body: Bring your phone right up to the box, and check the box has power.
scan.failed.headline: That didn't go through.
scan.failed.body: Check you're online, and scan the card again.
scan.denied.headline: The camera is off for this app.
scan.denied.body: The iPhone Camera app reads the card too: point it at the card and tap what appears.
home.footer.none: This week starts whenever you do.
leaving.headline: Ending in
leaving.body: Back in the box and it carries on.
session.out: This ends when your phone comes out of the box.
starttap.banner.title: Docked at {place}
end.evenings.label: Your days
end.evenings.none: The first is still to come.
end.evenings.body: Today's is the newest. They don't go away.
end.evenings.again: Today had already counted. A day counts once, however many times you set your phone down.
end.short: It counts from fifteen minutes in the box. This one is kept all the same.
autoclosed.headline: We closed this one for you.
autoclosed.body: Your phone went into the box at {time} and we never heard it come out. We've counted three hours and stopped there rather than guess.
autoclosed.counts: It still counts toward last night.
autoclosed.remove: That wasn't a real one — remove it
settings.title: Settings
settings.sub: Your box, your days, and the rules it keeps.
settings.box.label: Your box
settings.boxes.label: Your boxes
settings.liveactivity.off: The ring on your lock screen is turned off for this app.
settings.keep.label: Your days
settings.keep.body: Your days belong to this phone for now. Keep them with your Apple ID, and a new phone picks up where this one left off. Apple only tells us it's you, not your name or email.
settings.kept: A new phone picks up where this one left off.
settings.kept.title: Kept with your Apple ID
settings.elsewhere.title: That Apple ID already keeps your days
settings.elsewhere.body: Switch to it? What this phone has kept stays in your boxes' totals, and your sky becomes that one.
box.name.label: Its name
box.name.shared: Everyone at this box sees this name.
box.name.locked: Named by whoever first scanned it.
box.kept.label: What it has kept
box.become.label: What it has become
box.radio.label: Its radio
box.radio.connected: Connected. It hears your phone go in and come out.
box.radio.away: Out of range right now. It reconnects by itself when you're back.
box.radio.off: Bluetooth is off, so it can't hear your phone go in.
box.radio.unpaired: Not paired with its radio yet. Scan its card with your phone beside the box.
settings.forget.body: This phone stops being the box's. The box keeps everything; scan its card again to come back.
settings.forget.title: Forget this box?
settings.nudge.title: One nudge a day
settings.how.label: How it works
settings.how.1: Put your phone in a slot and it begins.
settings.how.2: It counts from fifteen minutes in.
settings.how.3: Take it out and it ends, unless it's back within five seconds.
settings.how.4: Left in overnight, we close it at three hours. It still counts.
settings.see.label: What we can see
settings.see.body: When your phone goes into a box and comes out, and which box, and when setting up or the box goes wrong, so it can be put right. Nothing about your screen, your apps, or where you are.
settings.see.others: Everyone at a box sees how many of you are in it, and what it has kept, added up. Never who wasn't there.
settings.delete.body: Your account and your sky go. The hours you spent at your boxes stay in their totals, with nothing that says they were yours.
settings.delete.title: Delete your account?
places.somewhere.title: Somewhere
error.retry: That didn't take. Try it again?
unreachable.headline: Not connected yet.
unreachable.body: The first time, this needs the internet for a moment. There's nothing else to set up.
